name: Volume Painting for Selection
definition: A 3D volumetric painting approach for selection definition where a user clicks on the image plane, casting a ray into the volume to find the first non-transparent voxel, then drawing a 3D Gaussian brush into the selection volume.
summary: Volume Painting for Selection defines fuzzy selection envelopes via additive or subtractive 3D Gaussian painting, differing from direct voxel modification.
